objectives.title: Admin lost password
objectives.prompt: Solve the WebGoat challenge "Admin lost password": log in as admin and submit the flag WebGoat shows you.
hints: The admin forgot where the password is stashed: look closely at every resource the challenge page loads, not only the HTML.

objectives.title: Without password
objectives.prompt: Solve the WebGoat challenge "Without password": log in as Larry without knowing his password and submit the flag.
hints: The login form checks the password with a database query built from your input: think SQL injection.

objectives.title: Without account
objectives.prompt: Solve the WebGoat challenge "Without account": cast a vote without being logged in and submit the flag.
hints: The voting endpoint only enforces the login on some HTTP methods: think HTTP verb tampering.
The flag comes back in a response header.

objectives.title: Admin password reset
objectives.prompt: Solve the WebGoat challenge "Admin password reset": reset the admin's password and submit the flag.
hints: Request a reset for your own account first and read the mail in WebWolf: how is the reset link built?
The application leaks its own source code somewhere under the challenge: look for a version control directory.

steps.title: Find the reset mail
steps.prompt: Which companion application receives the password reset mail? (name)

steps.title: Find the leaked source
steps.prompt: Which version control system's metadata directory exposes the application's source? (name)
